hero.description: Explore antiques, Soviet memorabilia, Georgian art, handmade souvenirs, vintage cameras and weekend market scenes at Dry Bridge Market in central Tbilisi.

hero.freshness: Google Maps rating checked in October 2026.

about.title: About the Market
about.description1: Dry Bridge Market (მშრალი ხიდის ბაზარი) is one of Tbilisi's best-known open-air flea markets, known for antiques, Soviet-era objects, Georgian paintings, handmade crafts and ever-changing local finds.
about.description2: This website is an independent visitor guide. Typical vendor hours are around 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with the widest selection usually on weekends. Admission is free. Address: PR23+96X, Tbilisi, Georgia, near the Mtkvari River and the Dry Bridge.
